nodes.title: Register the entity edit's refusal codes in the shared status table
nodes.summary: Five entity-edit refusal codes are added to the shared code-to-status table, and BUSINESS_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE_KEY stays 404 there. The comments in the file were removed.

nodes.title: Proof for the entity edit's refusal codes in the shared status table
nodes.summary: Eight tests over the shared code-to-status table and the curation mapper show the five new refusal codes render at the contract's statuses, that the retrieval 404 for BUSINESS_UNKNOWN_ATTRIBUTE_KEY is unchanged, and that no new refusal logs at error level.
